questionSnapshot.question: In which Disney animated film does Maleficent appear as the villain?

verification.context: English-language Disney character naming; original theatrical feature where a film is named. In which Disney animated film does Maleficent appear as the villain?

premise.reason: Maleficent is the evil fairy in the 1959 Sleeping Beauty feature; final wording does not claim chronological first appearance.
